subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers adopt the conflicting fork PR for this issue, ask that contributor to rebase with maintainer edits enabled, or authorize a clean OpenClaw-side replacement fix?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but automation should not create a competing fix while an open closing-syntax fork PR exists and current labels already mark the issue as linked to an open PR/no-new-fix-pr.

options.title: Authorize a clean replacement fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land a focused target-repo fix in the shared stripper with UI/TUI tests.

options.title: Wait for fork author refresh
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to rebase, resolve conflicts, and enable maintainer edits so their branch can be reviewed normally.

options.title: Keep parked for later
options.body: Leave this source-reproducible issue open until a maintainer has time to choose the fix path.

recommendation.title: Authorize a clean replacement fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land a focused target-repo fix in the shared stripper with UI/TUI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the exact shared stripper lines now in blame, making this the best routing candidate for the maintainer choice.
